Setting.Name: CareOnCloud::Audit::Enabled
Setting.Description: Enables tenant-safe normalized CareOnCloud audit events.

Setting.Name: CareOnCloud::Audit::ExportLimit
Setting.Description: Maximum audit events returned by one export page.

Setting.Name: CareOnCloud::Audit::IPHashSalt
